description: This file defines the Browser class and related classes for managing browser instances, contexts, and server communication in the Playwright core library. It includes methods for creating contexts, handling downloads, videos, server start/stop, and event management.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Abstract class representing a browser instance, managing contexts, downloads, videos, and server communication.

classes.name: BrowserServer
classes.description: Handles starting and stopping the browser server, including WebSocket and pipe server setup.

classes.name: BrowserProcess
classes.description: Interface defining the process control methods for a browser process.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with specified options, handling proxies and storage state.

methods.name: newContextForReuse
methods.description: Reuses or creates a new context based on provided parameters for efficiency.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts the browser server with specified options, returning connection details.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the browser server and cleans up resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser, optionally with a reason, and waits for disconnection.

methods.name: killForTests
methods.description: Kills the browser process for testing purposes.
